description: Implementation of a network link receiver that creates, binds, listens on sockets, and manages connections using SbSocketWaiter for asynchronous I/O, including thread management and socket handling.

classes.name: LinkReceiver::Impl
classes.description: Private implementation class managing socket server, connections, and threading for link reception.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::Run
methods.description: Initializes socket, binds, listens, and runs the main server loop.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::AddForAccept
methods.description: Adds listening socket to SbSocketWaiter for accept readiness.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::AddForRead
methods.description: Adds a connection socket to SbSocketWaiter for read readiness.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::OnReadReady
methods.description: Handles data available to read on a socket.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::RunThread
methods.description: Thread entry point to run the server loop.
